page.overview:
Who is Burlok Damminsson?

Burlok Damminson, also spelled Burlok Damminsson, is a Dwarf Master Engineer and the guildmaster of the Dwarf Engineers Guild, the leader of and most skilled Dwarf in the entire guild.

Dwarf engineers are very traditional in their views and take great pride in their workmanship. Dwarf machines are covered in ornate brasswork, elegant decorations, and precise engineering. Such things bring tears of joy to the eyes of Dwarf craftsmen, and Burlok is no exception in this respect. He is also a great traditionalist who discourages innovation and firmly believes that the old tried and tested ways are best. In this respect too he typifies the attitude of the Dwarf Engineers Guild whose objectives are to preserve knowledge and maintain standards of craftsmanship rather than to explore new ideas. Of course, some of the younger engineers oppose this view, and sometimes come up with startling and outlandish inventions, but these outrageous individuals invariably come to a bad end.

Burlok is no longer a young Dwarf. Some of the younger apprentices find it hard to believe that he ever was. In fact, though it is not widely known, Burlok was something of a rebel in his younger years. Along with his equally hot-headed friend Sven Hasselfriesan, he engaged in all kinds of illicit invention. They made many great discoveries and invented some of the most outlandish and powerful machines ever to grace a Dwarven workshop -- not that the Engineers Guild was aware of most of their work at the time. Among their many inventions were the warpfire distillery, the surprising aerial wonder rocket, and the legendary steam radiophone.

All of these inventions were discovered by Burlok's father when an experimental pressure vessel exploded, blowing off Burlok's arm. Afterwards, all of Sven's and Burlok's devices were destroyed. Subsequently Burlok sobered up a bit and saw the error of his ways. Sven Hasselfriesan went on to invent the alcohol vapour engine and built a boat powered by it. Eventually the Engineers Guild, though tolerant, was compelled to expel the anarchic and adventurous Sven, who was forced to endure the embarrassing Trouser Legs Ritual before he was thrown out of the guild.
